description: Open a pending order for a client and return a payment link. IMPORTANT: this does not pay for anything. The order stays unpaid until a human opens the returned payUrl and pays on the store's checkout. Give the link to the client or to someone at your agency — you cannot complete payment yourself, and you must not tell the client the placement is bought until check_order_status reports paid: true. Confirm the placements and the total with a human before calling this. No account or API key is required, but an unpaid order is deleted automatically after 72 hours, so send the link promptly.

clientReference.description: Your own reference for this client or campaign.

email.description: The payment link and receipt go here. Required to look the order up later.

firstName.description: Billing first name — whoever will pay.

quantity.description: How many of this placement; at least 1. Defaults to 1.

notes.description: Anything the editorial team should know.

placedBy.description: Who you are — your agency or product name. Recorded as an unverified claim, purely so we can tell orders apart.
